description: Drive a whole graph of GitHub issues to completion using background subagents. Queries the unblocked frontier through native GitHub issue dependencies, dispatches one implementer per ready issue into an isolated worktree, runs a spec-review agent against the result, lands the PR, then re-queries as each merge opens new edges. Use this whenever the user wants a set of linked issues worked through by agents rather than by hand — "orchestrate agents to implement these issues", "work through the issue chain", "dispatch background agents for my backlog", "implement this epic/milestone end to end", "queue up whatever's unblocked and keep going" — and whenever they describe a dependency chain, DAG, blocked-by graph, or parent issue with sub-issues that needs implementing. Applies even when they never say "orchestrate": a request to work several dependent issues automatically is this skill. Not for implementing one issue yourself, and not for creating the issues or the dependency edges in the first place.
